desc: Ideation: compare row-cut vs anti-diagonal cut; choose anti-diagonal (element-wise transitions, no sequential scan, no transposition needed)
Derive `ans = Σ_{v∈diag d} F[v]·(G[v↓]+G[v→])`, the `F_d/G_d` element-wise recurrences, the pg validity invariant, and the sample-1 hand check (456)
Implement the full anti-diagonal solution (I/O, geometry helpers, O(HW) build, query loop) — pure-Python-list version
Add numpy padded-array fast path for large `min(H,W)` (threshold 32), same index/shift logic, `%MOD` right after every multiply, no un-reduced dot
Verify padding/offset bounds `s + ln[d] ≤ ln[other] + 1` for both F and G directions, and `d=0` / `d=D-1` edge cases
Correctness verification: sample 1 full trace (456/666/822), 2×2 oscillation case with zeros and both special diagonals, aliasing/zip-truncation and pg-invariant proofs for all four move transitions
Overflow audit (int64 safety of add→multiply→mod and of the reduced-value `.sum()`)
Complexity/perf assessment: O(HW) build + O(min(H,W)) per query with ~7 numpy calls/query (≈2.6–4 s worst case at min(H,W)=447, Q=2·10⁵); memory trimmed for thin grids
